name: fold-stale-edit-of-a-lower-case-name-is-denied-through-a-negated-class-where-the-disk-folds-case
description: As fold 13 with a negated class: strict_mode.yaml lists docs/[!a-z]*.md, the disk holds docs/plan.md and A's pre-edit of docs/plan.md follows B's commit. As written, [!a-z] refuses p. On a case-insensitive disk (caseless) docs/plan.md also opens as docs/Plan.md, which the class accepts. Folded, a negated class refuses only a character no spelling outside it folds to; every lower-case letter has an upper-case spelling, so folded [!a-z] refuses nothing and accepts p, and A is denied as strict_mode 05 denies a stale edit, with the reason and summary.path echoing docs/plan.md as A sent it. Where the disk keeps case apart (nfd, none) no spelling of docs/plan.md is strict, and the pre-edit is allowed with the warn-mode collision warning and disk-differs notice, both naming docs/plan.md, as in fold 13. The two summary timestamps are ignored; every other summary field is compared. Both backends.
